## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] UI changes: gallery story and snapshots for every built-in theme, colors from theme tokens only
- [ ] Hot path touched: `scripts/perf.sh` still within budget
- [ ] Animations and sounds respect Reduce Motion and the sound settings
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
- [ ] Copied or adapted code recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- [ ] No tokens, real org names or real work item / PR content in code, fixtures or screenshots
